title: Point Roberts: Four Borders to School
status: approved by the user 2026-10-31 ("Approve all three"), no edits

lines.text: From this town, you can't reach the rest of your country without leaving it.
Water on three sides. Canada on the fourth.
The drive to the rest of America: forty kilometres, through Canada.
Zoom out, and you'll see what did it.
In 1846, a treaty split the West along the forty-ninth parallel.
Point Roberts hangs just below it.
Its school stops at third grade.
After that, kids ride forty minutes through Canada to Blaine.
Four border crossings, every school day.
Locals call it the best gated community in America.
Since 1987, even its tap water comes across the border.
Forty minutes to school. Four borders a day.
